capabilities: define, edit, reorder, and delete vault-wide variables in a settings panel
substitute {{name}} placeholders in Reading view across text, tables, headings, callouts, and code blocks
autocomplete variable names when typing {{ in the editor
highlight undefined variables and leave them as literal text
copy substituted text via the native code-block copy button
extras: Substitution happens only in Reading view; Source mode and Live Preview always show the raw {{name}} and note files are never modified.
motivation: The author kept setup notes with the same IP, hostname, or username scattered across many snippets and wanted a single place to change them.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep repeated values like IPs or hostnames consistent across many notes and update them from one place.
summary: Variable substitution plugin that lets you define named values once and render them as {{name}} placeholders across notes in Reading view.
